title: Brother-In-Law Forged Dissolution, Sold My $830K Fleet, Gave Me $5,500. So I Got My Boats Back
description: When my brother-in-law forged a dissolution, sold my $830K fleet of restored wooden speedboats, and handed me a $5,500 check, I retrieved our notarized partnership agreement from inside a 1936 Gar Wood’s engine compartment. Now he varnishes hulls for me wearing a shirt that says ‘Sunk My Trust’ and every rental receipt prints the fraud docket. #RevengeStory #FamilyBetrayal #ProRevenge
thumb_text: HE SOLD MY BOATS FOR $830K, NOW HE VARNISHES THEM
pinned_comment: If your brother-in-law forged a dissolution, stole your $830K fleet, and handed you a $5,500 check like you were nothing, would you have made him varnish hulls in a ‘Sunk My Trust’ shirt or taken him straight to court? Share what you would do in the comments!

thumb_lines.text: GAVE ME A $5,500 CHECK AND CALLED ME BROKE
I FOUND THE CONTRACT IN THE ENGINE
